reason: A local code-security review plugin that scans source files and git diffs, verifies fixes, analyzes dependencies, and produces policy-based reports.

summaries.zh: 用于扫描源代码和 Git diff 中的安全问题、验证修复结果、分析依赖风险并生成策略化报告的本地代码安全审查插件。
summaries.en: A local code-security review plugin that scans source files and Git diffs, verifies fixes, analyzes dependency risks, and generates policy-based reports.

capabilities: Scans files and directories for security rule violations
Reviews added lines in git diffs
Verifies whether findings were fixed or newly introduced
Analyzes dependency manifests for version and supply-chain risks
Writes scan state, baselines, policies, and exported reports with approval gates
